subject: Database Migration — Post-Migration Report
body:
Hi team,

The PostgreSQL migration (NEX-189) completed overnight.

- Start 02:05, end 05:48 IST (under the 4h window)
- PG 13.12 -> 16.1, events table partitioned, ~40% query improvement
- Standby live until Nov 6 (72h); zero data loss verified

Known issue: the post-migration index rebuild warned on documents.created_at. Opened NEX-244 — see email_08 for the incident that followed.

Thanks Arjun (primary on-call) and Riya (backup).

Diana
